💖 FINAL DONATION UPDATE – POON’S BIRTHDAY GIFT PROJECT 💖

Hello, OhmPoon PH family! This is the final update for Poon’s Birthday Gift Project, and we are officially closing this donation drive. 🥰

Thanks to everyone’s generosity, we set a goal of ₱4,000 and received a total of ₱4,300, exceeding our target. Your support made it possible for us to prepare a heartfelt birthday gift for Poon and make his special day even more meaningful. 🎁💙

We truly appreciate every single donation — big or small. Your love and support reflect how deeply Poon is cherished by his fans. 🌟

💌 A sincere thank you to all our donors, including those who chose to remain anonymous. Your kindness and trust mean so much to us.

📌 Donation Breakdown:
The full breakdown for this project will be shared soon for transparency.

Thank you for being part of this celebration and for helping us turn love into action. 💖

#PoonBirthdayGiftProject #OhmPoonPH #OhmPoon #โอห์มปูน #poon_mit12
